snippet.title: Elevator: Source - Fast Paced Co-op Elevator Simulation
snippet.description:
The arrangement of 'Pure Imagination' in this video is by Helen Marshall and you can see the song in full here: http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KrUak31dVqc

You can download the mod here: http://www.pixeltailgames.com/elevator/

Inker, Universal, Iyse, Novasol, Monkeyscythe, Cube, Sim, and Steviestar take an elevator ride.
